items.title: Ukrainian forces used Vampire bombers to deliver food and medicine to occupied Oleshky – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces used heavy Vampire bomber drones to deliver food, water and medicine across the Dnipro River to residents of occupied Oleshky.

items.title: Russen greifen erneut Energieobjekte an, in fünf Regionen Stromausfälle gemeldet
items.teaser: Nach dem russischen Drohnen- und Raketenangriff wurden am Mittwoch. 7. September in fünf Regionen der Ukraine Stromausfälle gemeldet.

items.title: Russia’s jet drones fly near 600 km/h now. Ukraine is building simulators for the 900 km/h ones it expects next
items.teaser: When a Russian jet drone and the drone chasing it move at the same speed, the pilot can barely tell the two apart—and the Russian models keep getting faster.

items.teaser: Mit August Hanning steht ein ehemals oberster Spion Deutschlands im Verdacht, seit Jahren Staatsgeheimnisse an interessierte Mächte zu verticken. Das geht nur mit Quellen, die sehr gierig oder sehr naiv sind. Beides schlimm, beides muss bekämpft werden, und zwar sofort.

items.teaser: Am Dienstag kommt es zur Hausdurchsuchung bei Ex-BND-Chef Hanning wegen des Verdachts der Spionage. Nun wird er am Bundesgerichtshof in Karlsruhe vorgeführt und muss in Untersuchungshaft.

items.title: Taliban and North Korea rubbed shoulders at Russia’s war games—one fuels Moscow’s war, the other needs its help
items.teaser: Two isolated governments in Russia's orbit turned up at the same drills—though only Kabul has said they met.

items.title: Drone debris damages five houses in Zhmerynka
items.teaser: In Zhmerynka, Vinnytsia region, five homes were damaged by debris from downed drones.

items.title: Latvia stops armed migrant push from Belarus, then loses border cameras to masked raiders hours later
items.teaser: The escorts threatened Latvian soldiers before the raiders slipped back to Belarus ahead of the border guards.

items.title: Ex-BND-Chef Hanning unter Spionage-Verdacht - "Wie ein Bankdirektor, der seine eigene Bank ausraubt"
items.teaser: Ex-BND-Chef August Hanning soll Geheiminformationen verkauft haben.

items.title: Ukraine receives another €1.2bn from EU for urgent defence needs
items.teaser: Ukraine has received another €1.2 billion under the EU's Ukraine Support Loan to fund drones, interceptors, ammunition and Ukrainian-made missiles.

items.title: Military representatives from all 32 NATO member states visit Kyiv
items.teaser: Military representatives from all 32 NATO member states visited Kyiv and met Commander-in-Chief Drapatyi to discuss Ukraine's defence priorities.

items.teaser: Die EU und die Bundesregierung haben zum 3. Jahrestag des terroristischen Überfalls der Hamas auf Israel der Opfer gedacht. items.title: 'We're ready to fight' — How a pipeline meant to prepare Kyiv for Russian strikes pitted Ukrainians against their city council
items.teaser: In one of Kyiv's hardest-hit districts, a heating pipeline meant to help residents weather Russian attacks this winter has instead pitted them against their own city's administration. items.title: Russians destroy publisher's warehouse again
items.teaser: A Russian strike has destroyed the Kyiv warehouse of the #knygolove publishing house, resulting in the loss of tens of thousands of books.

items.title: Media reports: Volgograd oil refinery halts operations following drone attack
items.teaser: The Volgograd Oil Refinery in Russia has completely halted oil refining after equipment was damaged in a drone attack on October 2.

items.title: EU provides Ukraine 1.2 billion euros for drones and missiles
items.teaser: "The money will be spent on drones, drone interceptors, drone ammunition, and missiles manufactured by Ukrainian entities," reads a European Commission press release.

items.title: Ukraine's General Staff reports strike on airfield in Russia's Bryansk Oblast
items.teaser: The General Staff has reported strikes on Russia's Seshcha airfield, electronic warfare sites and drone launch facilities in Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts.

items.title: EU ambassadors clear path for Ukraine to open two new accession clusters
items.teaser: Assuming all goes as planned, opening the two clusters could help Ukraine benefit from the European Commission's new "gradual integration" idea.

items.title: Number injured in Russian attack on Kremenchuk rises to 34, including two children
items.teaser: A Russian attack on Kremenchuk has killed two people and injured 34, including two children, and damaged five apartment buildings and 35 houses.

items.title: Hungary gives green light to opening of Clusters 2 and 3 for Ukraine
items.teaser: Hungary has agreed to allow Ukraine to move forward in its EU accession negotiations, clearing the way for the opening of Cluster 2, Internal Market, and Cluster 3, Competitiveness and Inclusive Growth.

items.title: NATO Military Committee delegation in Kyiv: Russia will not succeed in undermining support for Ukraine
items.teaser: A delegation from the NATO Military Committee, led by its chairman, Admiral Giuseppe Cavo Dragone, visited Kyiv for talks with the leadership of the General Staff of the Armed Forces regarding the situation on the battlefield and continued support for Ukraine.

items.title: Spionage-Vorwurf gegen Ex-BND-Chef - Ruf nach mehr Kontrolle
items.teaser: Ex-BND-Chef Hanning steht unter Spionageverdacht.

items.title: Selenskyj meldet Angriffe auf russische Ölanlagen und einen Übungsplatz
items.teaser: Die Verteidigungskräfte hätten vier Ziele angegriffen, die Russland dabei helfen, den Krieg zu finanzieren und zu führen.

items.title: 25-year-old Natalia, born in Russia, served in the Israeli army, returned to Ukraine during the full-scale invasion, and join the Armed Forces of Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainian society is not yet ready for the mandatory mobilization of women into the military, she believes.

items.title: Death toll in Oleksandriia rises to two
items.teaser: In Oleksandriya, Kirovohrad region, the death toll from Russian shelling has risen to two.

items.title: Lieferketten in Gefahr: Bundesregierung stoppt Verkauf von Logistikfirma an China
items.teaser: Das Bundeskartellamt hatte bereits grünes Licht gegeben, der Verfassungsschutz dann doch Bedenken angemeldet. Nun steht fest: China darf das Hamburger Logistikunternehmen Zippel nicht kaufen.

items.title: Over a third of Ukrainians expect more military aid from EU – poll
items.teaser: A poll has found that 34.9% of Ukrainians see increased EU military assistance as the EU's main security role for Ukraine.

items.title: Three children's bodies recovered from Pryluky rubble as death toll rises to nine, with 38 injured
items.teaser: In Pryluky, Chernihiv region, the death toll from the Russian strike has risen to nine; the bodies of three children were recovered from the rubble.

items.title: Raketenangriff auf Pryluky: Drei Kinder tot aus Trümmern geborgen, Zahl der Todesopfer steigt auf neun, die der Verletzten auf 38
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Todesopfer durch den russischen Raketenangriff ist in der Stadt Pryluky in der Region Tschernihiw auf acht gestiegen.

items.title: Spionageverdacht: Ex-BND-Chef Hanning festgenommen
items.teaser: Der mutmaßliche Informant des ehemaligen BND-Chefs August Hanning, Manfred D., wurde seit Monaten in seinem Haus in Geretsried, Bayern observiert und trug den Codenamen „Augner“.

items.title: Bird sanctuary in Kyiv Oblast catches fire due to Russian strike
items.teaser: A Russian strike hit Sadyba Niushanik, a bird sanctuary in Kyiv Oblast that cares for many birds and rescues dozens of orphaned storks every year.

items.title: Norway's 2027 budget includes almost $9 billion in new Ukraine support
items.teaser: The money would be funneled into Norway's Nansen Support Program, named after humanitarian Fridtjof Nansen, who led famine relief efforts in Ukraine in the early 1920s.

items.title: Mögliche Gefährdung für Quellen: Britische Geheimdienste wegen Hanning-Fall in Sorge
items.teaser: Westliche Geheimdienste sind geschockt, nachdem Ex-BND-Chef Hanning wegen Spionageverdachts festgenommen wurde. Sie leiten Sicherheitsmaßnahmen ein. Der Vorsitzende des Parlamentarischen Kontrollgremiums wirkt gelassen.

items.title: Poll shows how many Ukrainians see EU as reliable security partner
items.teaser: A poll has found that 64.6% of Ukrainians consider the EU a reliable long-term security and defence partner.

items.title: Drones halt operations at another Russian oil refinery
items.teaser: Russia's Volgograd oil refinery, owned by Lukoil, suspended operations after a Ukrainian drone attack, Reuters reports citing industry sources.

items.title: Satellite images reveal damage from strikes on Russian plant producing Kh-59 missile components
items.teaser: Satellite images have revealed damage from a 25 September attack on Russia's Zavod Iskra plant in Ulyanovsk, which is involved in producing components for Kh-59 missiles.

items.title: Death toll from Russian missile strike on Pryluky rises to nine: bodies of three children recovered from under rubble – video
items.teaser: The death toll from a Russian missile strike on Pryluky has risen to nine, including three children, and 38 people have been injured.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit two oil facilities, training range in Russia – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Ukraine's Defense Forces struck four targets that help Russia finance and wage its war, including two oil facilities and a training range in three Russian regions.

items.title: Drei Jahre nach Hamas-Terror: Mutter von Shani Louk spricht über Verlust
items.teaser: Mehr als zwölfhundert Menschen wurden beim Terrorangriff der islamistischen Hamas am 7. Oktober 2023 getötet. Angehörige der Opfer berichten über den Schmerz des Verlusts.

items.title: Drei Jahre nach dem Terror - Warum Tel Aviv sicherer ist als Berlin
items.teaser: Jüdisches Ehepaar plant wegen Antisemitismus die Auswanderung nach Israel.

items.title: Russian attack leaves a third of Pryluky residents without gas
items.teaser: A Russian attack overnight has damaged a medium-pressure gas pipeline in Pryluky, Chernihiv Oblast, temporarily leaving more than 18,000 of the city's 51,000 residents without gas.

items.title: Zelensky on Russian attack: Infrastructure in Kyiv and 12 regions hit, energy sector key target
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that during the latest air attack, Russian forces used 70 missiles, many of them ballistic ones, as well as Shahed drones, with energy infrastructure being a key target. Infrastructure in Kyiv and 12 regions came under attack.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 202 Gefechte an der Front, Russen machen Druck in Richtung Pokrowsk
items.teaser: Am 6. Oktober kam es zu 202 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: Twelve killed and 40 injured, including children, in Russian attack on Ukraine – photos, video
items.teaser: A combined Russian missile and drone strike across Ukraine killed 12 people and injured 40 others, damaging high-rise residential buildings in Pryluky and Kyiv.

items.title: Five dead in Pryluky, two each in Kyiv, Kremenchuk, and Oleksandriia: Russia’s night of 70 missiles
items.teaser: Five children were among the 26 people injured when a missile collapsed part of a five-story building.

items.title: Russia prepares information operation on situation in Oleshky – Ukraine's Security Service
items.teaser: Ukraine's Security Service says Russia is preparing a series of information and psychological operations involving residents of occupied Oleshky in Kherson Oblast.

items.title: Ukrainian forces combine robots with drones to strike Russians deep in the rear. Interview with the commander of "NC13"
Israel gedenkt der Opfer des Hamas-Überfalls am 7. Oktober 2023
items.teaser: Vor drei Jahren überfielen islamistische Terroristen Israel. Etwa 1.200 Menschen wurden getötet, Hunderte verschleppt. In Tel Aviv und an anderen Orten im Land wird der Opfer des Hamas-Überfalls gedacht.

items.title: Death toll from Russian missile strike on Pryluky rises to five, 25 injured
items.teaser: The death toll from a Russian strike on an apartment building in Pryluky, Chernihiv region, has risen to five.

items.title: Ukraine's Energy Ministry warns of possible emergency power cuts following Russian attack
items.teaser: Ukraine's Ministry of Energy warned that emergency power outages may be applied in certain oblasts if the power grid situation worsens following Russian strikes.

items.title: Jüdischer Alltag in Deutschland: Leben mit Sicherheitsvorkehrungen
items.teaser: Seit dem Terrorangriff der Hamas auf Israel 2023 hat sich die Bedrohungslage für Jüdinnen und Juden in Deutschland weiter verschärft. Hinter Anschlagsplänen hierzulande stecken mutmaßlich auch iranische Netzwerke. Von J. Röhmel und S. Wolf.

items.title: Raketenangriff auf Pryluky: Fünf Tote, 25 Verletzte
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Todesopfer durch den russischen Raketenangriff ist in der Stadt Pryluky in der Region Tschernihiw auf fünf gestiegen.

items.title: Dovzhenko Film Studio in Kyiv damaged again in Russian attack
items.teaser: The building of the Oleksandr Dovzhenko National Film Studio in Kyiv was damaged in a Russian attack early on October 7.

items.title: The 2026 ICC Rules and the Optional Terms of Reference: End of an Era or Old Wine in a New Bottle?

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 117 Drohnen, fünf ballistische Raketen und 39 Marschflugkörper
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat fünf ballistische Raketen, 39 Marschflugkörper und 117 Drohnen neutralisiert, womit die russischen Besatzer seit Montagabend, am 6. Oktober das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hatten.

items.title: Israel hat seit dem Hamas-Massaker 100.000 Ziele angegriffen
items.teaser: Vor drei Jahren ermordeten Hamas-Terroristen rund 1.

items.title: Russian attack damages Dovzhenko Film Studio for third time
items.teaser: A Russian attack on Kyiv has pierced the roofs of two sound stages at the historic Dovzhenko Film Studio, following previous heavy damage sustained in June.

items.title: Russian missile strike on Pryluky kills four, injures 20
items.teaser: The death toll from a Russian strike on an apartment building in Pryluky, Chernihiv region, has risen to four.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia marks Putin's birthday with one of its most vile attacks, killing 11 Ukrainians
items.teaser: Russia launched 70 missiles and Shahed drones at Ukraine overnight, killing 11 people and injuring more than 30, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says.
